name: notes
description: Turn finished work into written documents: root-cause analyses, reusable-pattern learnings, release notes, daily task logs, and narrative debugging blog posts.

interface.shortDescription: Write up what you just built or just fixed
interface.longDescription: Notes bundles the five skills that turn a finished session into a document someone else can read: rca writes a nine-section root-cause analysis, insight captures one reusable pattern into the repo's docs/guide/learnings/, release-note groups git history into user-facing themes, task-history appends a JIRA-plus-PR entry to a daily log, and blog-dev-learnings turns a debugging war story into a Korean blog post. Each skill mines the current conversation instead of asking you to retype it.
defaultPrompt: Write an RCA for the incident we just debugged.
Record what I did this session.
